catalog_dispositions.published_result_en: Formal Qwen3.5-35B-A3B BF16 TP2 testing completed three alternating fresh-process pairs. Throughput changes were +0.292%, +0.214%, and -0.516% (geometric aggregate -0.004%); TTFT/TPOT changes were also sub-percent. All 210 paired quality outputs and reasoning hashes were exact. Static decay is qualified as quality-equivalent in this cell, but no stable speedup is demonstrated.

catalog_dispositions.published_result_en: Current 0.2.0 code is not beneficial in the tested Qwen3.5-35B-A3B TP2 eager AgentX cells. Across four first-turn shapes (three retained repetitions each), total-time medians ranged from 0.60% faster to 0.81% slower, but TTFT regressed in every cell by 2.09% to 4.43%; exact 128-token output hashes matched in 0/4 cells. A real concurrency-2 probe failed closed and terminated the engine. A component-only host submission change was 18.33% faster while synchronized device time stayed near 68 us, so it does not establish end-to-end gain.

decision_zh: 本次核验范围内，没有另一个已证明相对r8提升完整模型性能且质量合格的可直接开启MOD。唯一首要推进项是继续既有restore/RMS验证；BidKV与OpSet仅先做瓶颈/路径资格检查。
